title: Sub-Scope Detail Delete Delivery
summary: add a manage-only Delete action for one validated displayed sub-scope document with exact preview, confined apply, targeted rebuild, and list reconciliation
content_html:
Sub-Scope Detail Delete Delivery

Status And Order

Proposed as SSI-2, after Sub-Scope Report Contribution Delivery. Implementation has not started.

SSI-2 is the first new user workflow in the feature. It proves the detail toolbar, exact-target mutation, local rebuild, route repair, and inventory refresh path before selection and package preparation widen the collection surface.

Complete Outcome

Manage mode shows Delete in the detail toolbar on the same header row as Back only after docs_subscope has validated and rendered one listed document.

Delete previews and, after explicit confirmation, removes exactly:

{ scope, sub_scope, doc_id }

It rebuilds only the affected child collection, removes subdoc from the URL with replacement history, refreshes the management inventory, and returns to the list. Public mode has no button and does not load the controller, delete client, modal, or mutation workflow.

Change Classification

kind work
shipped and retained main-index Delete workflow and confirmation patterns; managed target resolver; sub-scope builders; report detail validation
extended document-delete client, capability, service planning/apply, activity, and rebuild support an exact sub-scope target
refactored shared delete mechanics may be extracted where parent and child mutations genuinely share behavior
genuinely new rendered sub-scope detail Delete action and its collection-local reconciliation

This is not sub-scope lifecycle deletion and must not reuse the capability that deletes an entire configured sub-scope.

UI And Target Contract

  • The button exists only in a validated detail state.
  • Loading, failed, unknown, unlisted, list, and unmounted states have no Delete target.
  • The button label, confirmation title, preview rows, and focus return identify the exact document.
  • Confirmation defaults focus to Cancel.
  • Cancel leaves the detail and URL unchanged.
  • The workflow never derives a target from the URL, selected parent document, title, focused row, or Tag Registry association.
  • Normal success emits no redundant status message; blockers, stale state, unavailable data, and errors remain visible.

The Delete implementation is manage-owned and lazy. The shared report only provides the validated target and toolbar host.

Service And Mutation Contract

Preview and apply retain one exact normalized target. Apply re-resolves the source after confirmation and rejects a stale or changed target before writing.

For a sub-scope document:

  • resolve only the configured one-level child source root;
  • require source filename/front-matter identity agreement;
  • reject multiple IDs and hierarchy expansion;
  • delete only that one canonical Markdown source;
  • never inspect or alter the parent scope's default document;
  • rebuild the child manifest, by-ID projection, and child search output;
  • do not rebuild the parent index-tree, Recent, or global search;
  • retain scope, sub_scope, and doc_id in preview, result, and activity; and
  • never read or update Studio JSON.

The existing parent-scope Delete contract remains unchanged. Shared mechanics must not force parent hierarchy/default-document semantics into the flat child collection.

Independent Ownership

An external reference is not a blocker. Deleting a tag document may leave a stale Tag Registry doc_id; that is allowed by Independent Canonical Documents.

Preview and apply use exact doc_id; title is display data and does not participate in mutation validation.

In Scope

  • One manage-only Delete button in the validated detail header.
  • Capability-aware availability and busy state.
  • Write-free preview, explicit confirmation, stale-target revalidation, and exact apply.
  • Confined source deletion and targeted child rebuild.
  • URL replacement, detail teardown, inventory refresh, and list return.
  • Exact-target identity, cancel, failure, and retry behavior.
  • Focused client, service, mutation, activity, report-controller, public isolation, and realistic UI evidence.

Not In Scope

  • Bulk or checkbox-backed Delete.
  • Deleting the report parent, Tag Registry record, tag alias, or configured sub-scope.
  • Cascade, synchronization, association repair, or delete prevention based on external references.
  • Choosing or navigating to a replacement document.
  • Parent index reload or sidebar selection change.
  • Undo, Trash, archive, or filtering.

Delivery Tracker

[ ] SSI-2.0 — Freeze Exact Delete Semantics

  • [ ] Trace the existing parent Delete client, planner/apply, confirmation, capability, activity, and rebuild owners.
  • [ ] Trace the managed sub-scope target resolver and child build entrypoints.
  • [ ] Define the exact preview/result shapes and stale-target proof.
  • [ ] Add test-owned ordinary, missing, mismatched, unconfigured-child, cancel, and stale-source fixtures.
  • [ ] Confirm that no parent hierarchy/default-document rule is valid for the child mutation.

Review gate: approve the singular target and mutation boundary before adding the UI action.

[ ] SSI-2.1 — Extend Preview And Apply

  • [ ] Add target-aware client and service entry without changing existing parent Delete requests.
  • [ ] Reuse the central managed-document resolver.
  • [ ] Implement write-free preview and confirmed exact apply.
  • [ ] Add suppression, atomic deletion, child rebuild, response, diagnostics, and activity behavior.
  • [ ] Prove that multiple IDs, path escape, stale source, and external association payloads cannot broaden the mutation.

Review gate: service evidence deletes one synthetic child and only its derived child outputs.

[ ] SSI-2.2 — Add The Detail Workflow

  • [ ] Contribute Delete only for a validated detail target.
  • [ ] Lazy-load its client/workflow and reuse the existing confirmation modal contract.
  • [ ] Reconcile successful deletion to list state with replacement history and a refreshed inventory.
  • [ ] Preserve the parent index, report selection, and unrelated caches.
  • [ ] Cover cancel, blocker, stale-state, service-unavailable, rebuild-failure, retry, Back/Forward, and unmount behavior.

Review gate: manually review ordinary exact-target preview states, narrow header layout, focus, and recovery.

[ ] SSI-2.3 — Isolation And Closeout

  • [ ] Run focused target, mutation, service route, controller/module, report, public read-only, and targeted-build checks.
  • [ ] Use synthetic test-owned sources for destructive route/browser evidence.
  • [ ] Confirm the public import graph excludes Delete implementation modules.
  • [ ] Run the maintained Docs Viewer profile at the integration boundary.
  • [ ] Independently review source/generated effects and record untested surfaces.
  • [ ] Transfer only the shipped exact-delete contract to durable owners.

Completion Gate

SSI-2 is complete only when one validated child can be deleted without touching another document, external canonical data, the parent index, or the public runtime.
